mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which often precedes an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a strengthening labor market, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% over two months, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in the same period, indicates robust consumer demand and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over a quarter signals a significant economic contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined by more than 1% over a quarter.
